sections.title: Sound of the letter pé
paragraphs: You say the name of this letter as (pé) /pe/. Its main sound is heard in the word (porte) /pɔʁt/, which means door. This letter makes two sounds across different words.

sections.title: How to say the letter pé
paragraphs: Press your lips tightly together to stop the air. Release your lips sharply so the air bursts out. Keep your vocal cords resting. A voiceless sound means your voice is off and your throat does not shake. Place your hand on your throat to check that it does not shake.

sections.title: Spelling of the letter pé
paragraphs: At the start of a word or inside a word before a vowel, this letter sounds like the first sound in (pomme) /pɔm/. At the end of many common words, this letter is a silent letter and you do not pronounce it, as in (trop) /tʁo/ or (drap) /dʁa/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid with the letter pé
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of air at the start of a word. A sound followed by a small puff of air is called aspirated, like the p in English pen. Hold a flat hand before your lips when you speak. Keep your lips tight and release them cleanly without any puff of breath.
